# Workflow activation checklist
CI template is inactive until Cargo workspace exists and verified action SHAs/toolchain/platform prerequisites are configured. Add separate workflows for cargo-deny/license and advisory checks, dependency review where available, secret scanning, localization validation, docs links, fuzz smoke, benchmarks and release packaging. Release workflow must build from protected tags, use owner-approved environment, produce checksums, SBOM, provenance and signed/notarized packages where applicable. Never publish on PR. Verify permissions, pin actions, avoid untrusted interpolation and cache poisoning. Do not claim signing until credentials and platform validation exist.
